purpose: Teach: 通告/知らさ/運送/日報/年内/償却/用地/代わる

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、立ち退きの通告、地域住民に、出しました。
lines.en: We've issued eviction notices to all residents in the area.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. No inflection on difficult information. Even pace, slight pause after 'notices' to let it settle. Clean closure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。捜査の進捗、御社にも、知らされている範囲で、共有しています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm sharing the investigation progress with you to the extent we're able to disclose.
lines.style: Attentive and cooperative tone. Steady pacing. Light emphasis on 'to the extent' — careful, lawful. Respectful half-beat before closing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、運送業者を装って、移動しておりました。
lines.en: The suspect was moving around posing as a logistics worker.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery, like reading case notes. Neutral weight on each phrase. No editorializing. Clinical precision throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、日報を、警察に提出することも、可能です。
lines.en: Yes. We can also submit our daily reports to the police if that would be helpful.
lines.style: Willing and practical. Slight lift on 'also' — offering additional support. Warm professionalism, not stiff. Ready to cooperate further.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 捜査、年内に、目処をつけられそうです。
lines.en: We should be able to close the investigation before year's end.
lines.style: Measured optimism. Steady cadence on the timeline. Light emphasis on 'should' — cautious confidence, not a promise. Calm finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害品、償却扱い、検討する必要、出てきました。
lines.en: Yes. We'll need to review how to handle the damaged goods for accounting purposes.
lines.style: Businesslike, noting a practical task. Slight pause before 'accounting' — shifting into operational detail. No rush, methodical.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察署の用地、地域内で、変更されました。
lines.en: The police station location in the area has been updated.
lines.style: Brief, informational. Even tone. No extra emphasis. Factual announcement delivered without dwelling. Clean and direct.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。担当に代わる形で、ご報告、申し上げます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll brief the responsible party and follow up with you.
lines.style: Confirming closure. Warm professionalism, taking ownership. Steady assurance. Final beat of courtesy — almost a small bow in the voice.
